themeDescription: Bruised vegetables, near-expiry dairy & stale bakery

challenges.title: Fresh tomatoes received severely bruised and unhygienic
challenges.shortDescription: Resolve quality complaint for fresh farm produce damaged during careless bike commute.
challenges.mission: Acknowledge produce grade lapse, issue 100% no-questions-asked refund, and feedback to dark store procurement.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Look at these tomatoes! They are squished, oozing juice, and completely rotten. You advertise farm-fresh quality, but this is unfit for human consumption!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: clean hygiene standards and immediate compensation

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Mentions ordering from competitor next time if quality control is this careless.
unacceptablePromises: Do not argue about acceptable produce bruising.

challenges.title: Artisan sandwich bread delivered with same-day expiration date
challenges.shortDescription: Handle a customer who bought 3 loaves of multi-grain bread only to discover they expire in 4 hours.
challenges.mission: Explain dark store shelf-life promise failure, arrange fresh morning batch replacement, and credit customer.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I bought 3 packets of brown bread for the week, and every single packet has today's date stamped as Best Before! How can a family eat 3 loaves in 4 hours?

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: fresh stock with minimum 3-day shelf life

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Points out that the app promised 'Baked Today' freshness.
hiddenObjectives: Issue full refund for all 3 loaves
Flag dark store inventory FIFO breach
possibleSolutions: Full refund + free replacement from tomorrow's early bake
unacceptablePromises: Do not suggest freezing expired bread as a remedy.
